summary: Goploader is a self-hosted file sharing utility written in Go and distributed under the MIT licence. It provides a web-based interface and command-line compatibility with standard tools like curl, httpie, and wget, featuring server-side encryption for stored data.
goodFor: It suits individual users or small teams who want a lightweight, command-line friendly file transfer endpoint on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: Development activity has slowed down significantly, and the project has a modest community footprint compared to broader cloud storage alternatives.
deployNotes: As a compiled Go binary, it typically requires a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and persistent local storage for uploaded files.
